scope: Static Java class-file and bytecode parsing only. No sample class was loaded and no Krypton method was invoked. Arbitrary string values, credentials, license values, and encrypted blobs are not retained.
limitations: Captured classes may omit feature code that has not been loaded at capture time.
Constructor label candidates are labels observed in bytecode, not proof that a class implements that feature.
Encrypted string constants and dynamic/bootstrap calls may reduce readability; this analysis does not execute decryptors.
Bytecode/native counts describe this captured JAR only, not the packed native DLL.
